name: How long does it take to install crown molding in an average-sized room?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install crown molding in an average-sized room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for crown molding depends on the room size, the complexity of the molding profile, and the ceiling height. For an average-sized room (e.g., 12x15 feet) with a straightforward profile, installation can typically be completed within one to two days. Larger rooms, intricate designs, or properties with many corners and irregular wall angles may require more time, potentially three to four days or more. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for an average room is typically 1-2 days, but can take longer for larger rooms or complex designs.
